children: HDFC Bank shares traded flat at ₹716 on the NSE at 11.40 am on Wednesday, after opening at ₹714.90 and rising to an intraday high of ₹720.30. The stock had closed at ₹716.55 in the previous trading session.
The stock’s movement comes after HDFC Bank soared nearly 3 per cent before close in the previous session following the bank’s move ahead with its CEO succession process.
The bank submitted the names of two candidates to the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) for approval.
HDFC Bank’s absolute returns stood at 4.18 per cent for the week, while the stock declined 1.53 per cent over the month. On a YTD basis, the stock fell 27.78 per cent.
The total traded volume stood at 119.42 lakh shares, while the traded value was ₹856.81 crore.
HDFC Bank’s total market capitalisation stood at ₹11.02 lakh crore at 11.40 am. The stock’s adjusted P/E was 13.78.

title: HDFC Bank shares trade flat after rising in previous session
